因子路由 / 公式 ⚠ FE DSL 暂不支持

log( down_avg/up_avg ) with volume regime amplification
依赖列: open, high, low, close, volume

📚 字段与算子释义

输入字段

字段含义说明
open开盘价基础行情字段
high最高价基础行情字段
low最低价基础行情字段
close收盘价基础行情字段
volume成交量基础行情字段
amplification放大系数对信号的放大项
down_avg平均下行量/区间下行方向的均值
regime状态量能/波动等状态变量
up_avg平均上行量/区间上行方向的均值

算子

算子含义
loglog(x) → 自然对数

🔬 陌生算子/字段释义

算子/字段含义
ts_pctd 期变化率：(x − x_shift(d)) / x_shift(d)

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 ret：close.pct_change()
  2. 计算 down：ret < 0
  3. 计算 up：ret >= 0
  4. 计算 range_：high - low
  5. 计算 down_range：range_.where(down, 0)
  6. 计算 up_range：range_.where(up, 0)
  7. 计算 down_avg：down_range.滚动窗口(20, min_periods=10).sum() / down.滚动窗口(20, min_periods=10).sum()
  8. 计算 up_avg：up_range.滚动窗口(20, min_periods=10).sum() / up.滚动窗口(20, min_periods=10).sum()
  9. 计算 ratio：down_avg / up_avg
  10. 计算 raw_asym：np.log(ratio.clip(lower=1e-6))
  11. 计算 volume_regime：alpha_tools.classify_volume_regime(volume, window=20)
  12. 计算 high_vol：volume_regime == high
  13. 计算 low_vol：volume_regime == low
  14. 计算 factor：np.where(high_vol, raw_asym * 1.5, np.where(low_vol, raw_asym * 0.5, raw_asym))
来源：由原始 Python 代码逐句翻译（字段/算子释义见下方）

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_asym_vol_gated(df): df_copy = df.copy() ret = df_copy["close"].pct_change() down = ret < 0 up = ret >= 0 range_ = df_copy["high"] - df_copy["low"] down_range = range_.where(down, 0) up_range = range_.where(up, 0) down_avg = down_range.rolling(20, min_periods=10).sum() / down.rolling(20, min_periods=10).sum().replace(0, np.nan) up_avg = up_range.rolling(20, min_periods=10).sum() / up.rolling(20, min_periods=10).sum().replace(0, np.nan) ratio = down_avg / up_avg.replace(0, np.nan) raw_asym = np.log(ratio.clip(lower=1e-6)) volume_regime = alpha_tools.classify_volume_regime(df_copy["volume"], window=20) high_vol = volume_regime == "high" low_vol = volume_regime == "low" factor = np.where(high_vol, raw_asym * 1.5, np.where(low_vol, raw_asym * 0.5, raw_asym)) df_copy["factor_asym_vol_gated"] = factor "kw">class="kw">return df_copy["factor_asym_vol_gated"]
